minutes.headline: Committee heard MCAS results and principals' reports and approved three policy updates; no budget votes.
minutes.summary: The committee approved a small line-item transfer and prior minutes, then heard building updates from the principals and a long presentation of state test results and the new accountability system. It discussed charter wording for selecting a superintendent, approved three policy updates, and talked about literacy planning and upcoming agendas.

what_happened.line: The committee moved to waive the third reading and approve policies 1202, 1700 and 2200; the vote result was not audible in the recording.
The committee moved to recommend the word 'appoint' in the charter language on selecting a superintendent; the result was not audible.
A motion to accept a small line-item transfer from sewer dumping fees to an equipment line, for a tractor and snow removal estimate, was made; the result was not audible.
The committee heard a long presentation on state test results and the new accountability system, after principals' building reports.
A return visit on kindergarten registration and space needs will follow preliminary registration numbers, in late February or early March.

why_it_matters: The wording on how a superintendent is chosen and the three policy updates shape how the district is run, but the minutes do not record how the votes came out.
The kindergarten space discussion and the shed estimate point to building and capital costs that may come back in a later budget cycle.
